Detecting these unusual cosmic events could reveal the existence of primordial black holes and help solve the mystery of dark matter.

docs.title: Primordial black hole
A mysterious gap hints at black holes born from stars that never exploded
docs.snippet: Massive stars may be quietly collapsing into black holes without ever producing the spectacular supernova explosions scientists typically expect. A surprising pattern in 257 black hole mergers suggests these mysterious stellar disappearances could explain the origins of a large population of black holes throughout the universe.

docs.title: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars
